lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid-like arrangement of circular high-luminance pixel clusters, primarily organized into five to six observable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of slightly higher pixel intensity crossing the horizontal spot rows, forming a coordinate-like grid system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear carinal feature is visible running horizontally above the mid-flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow fish (high-intensity yellow pixels) near the dorsal surface and a dark, elongated silhouette (remora) below the ventral surface.
